summary: PTIMER provides a hardware clock counter used by nvkm_msec for every wait and delay across all subsystems. It configures a frequency from the crystal clock via write registers, reads a 64-bit counter with a double-read loop to avoid torn values, and provides alarm interrupts when the counter matches a programmed value.

init.what: Calculates frequency dividers from the crystal clock and writes the multiplier, numerator and denominator registers to configure the timer to 31.25 MHz

intr.what: Reads the interrupt status register and acknowledges the alarm interrupt bit then triggers the alarm handler if set

read.what: Reads the 64-bit timer counter from two 32-bit registers in a retry loop to avoid torn reads and returns the combined value

time.what: Writes a 64-bit time value split into high and low 32-bit parts to two hardware registers to compare or set the timer

alarm_init.what: Writes a target time value to the alarm register and enables the alarm interrupt bit in the interrupt enable register

alarm_fini.what: Writes zero to the interrupt enable register to disable all timer alarm interrupts
